evidence: fratellobigio says T3 Code works well with a Claude subscription in Kubernetes, using persistent storage for configs and repos; the comment notes no official Docker image.

evidence_sources.author: fratellobigio
evidence_sources.excerpt: I use a T3 Code pod in a kubernetes Deployment (sadly no official Docker image), with a PVC so configs and cloned repos survive pod restarts. Seems to work quite well with my Claude subscription (no GPU in my homelab yet)

source_story_title: Show HN: Pi pod – Run your pi coding agent in sandboxes on your own server
